# Closeout Summary — <Item ID>

Required before a Tier 1 project can move to **Closed** (the registry blocks the
transition without it). The workspace becomes read-only on closeout and retention
labeling is applied (see project-workspaces spec).

## 1. Outcome
Did the project deliver what the charter promised? What shipped, what didn't, and
what changed along the way?

## 2. KPI effect
For each KPI the charter claimed: where did it actually move, measured how, as of when?
If a KPI didn't move, say so plainly — the registry keeps the record.

| KPI ID | Charter expectation | Actual effect | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

## 3. Lessons learned
What would you tell the lead of the next similar project? 3-5 bullets, specific beats
generic. (These feed the portfolio review; anonymized themes go to the TCC.)

## 4. Loose ends
Open items intentionally not done, with the reason and where they now live (deferred
request IDs, follow-up work, handoffs).

## 5. Financial/staffing note (optional)
Actual cost and effort vs. estimate, if tracked. Used to improve future estimation,
not to judge teams.

## 6. Sign-off
| Role | Name | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Lead | | |
| Sponsor | | |
